questions.stem: When should you read the three questions of a Part 3 conversation?
choices: During the directions, before the audio
Only after answering the first one

fr.rule: Lire les questions avant l'audio guide l'écoute.
why_wrong: A : vous ne retiendrez pas les détails.
B : vous perdez l'avantage principal.
D : trop tard pour anticiper.

en.rule: Reading the questions before the audio guides your listening.
why_wrong: A: you will not remember the details.
B: you lose the main advantage.
D: too late to anticipate.

questions.stem: Where is the answer to 'What will the woman do next?' usually found?
choices: It is never in the audio
At the end of the conversation

fr.rule: La prochaine action est annoncée en fin de conversation.
why_wrong: A : la réponse est toujours dans l'audio.
B : le début donne le sujet.
D : il n'y a pas de titre.

en.rule: The next action comes at the end of the conversation.
why_wrong: A: the answer is always in the audio.
B: the beginning gives the topic.
D: there is no title.

questions.stem: The correct answer says 'postpone', but you heard 'put off'. What does this show?
choices: The answer is a paraphrase of what was said

fr.rule: Les bonnes réponses sont souvent des paraphrases.
why_wrong: A : c'est une paraphrase normale.
B : non, c'est une paraphrase.
C : les réponses reformulent le plus souvent.
A: it is a normal paraphrase.
B: no, it is a paraphrase.
C: answers usually reword.

questions.stem: Why should you check who speaks in the question ('the man' or 'the woman')?
choices: Because the questions are in random order
Because the voices are always similar
Because the information may come from the other speaker

fr.rule: Un détail attribué au mauvais locuteur est un piège.
why_wrong: A : faux.
B : elles suivent l'ordre de la conversation.
C : ce n'est pas la raison.

en.rule: A detail attributed to the wrong speaker is a trap.
why_wrong: A: false.
B: they follow the order of the conversation.
C: that is not the reason.

questions.stem: What is a common trap with places and dates in Part 3?
choices: They are mentioned and then rejected

fr.rule: Une info citée puis écartée n'est pas la réponse.
why_wrong: B : souvent écartés ensuite.
C : ils sont souvent mentionnés.
D : pas systématiquement.

en.rule: Information mentioned then dismissed is not the answer.
why_wrong: B: often dismissed afterwards.
C: they are often mentioned.
D: not systematically.
